name: Invoice Payment Reconciliation Advice V 01
definition: The message InvoicePaymentReconciliationAdvice is sent by a payer to a payee to indicate attribution of payments to instalment of payment obligations in order to simplify the account netting or clearing when a lot of invoices are paid with a unique payment (for instance an SCT or an SDD).|The message contains references to payment instructions, may reference other messages and may include referenced data.|The message can carry digital signatures if required by context.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Set of characteristics that unambiguously identify the letter, common parameters, documents and identifications.

ReconciliationCount.name: Reconciliation Count
ReconciliationCount.definition: Number of reconciliation lists as control value.

ItemCount.name: Item Count
ItemCount.definition: Total number of individual items in all lists.

ControlSum.name: Control Sum
ControlSum.definition: Total of all individual amounts included in all lists, irrespective of currencies or direction.
